The two reserved sites have no official plans yet, so they start as a flat footprint. Slide up to 45 storeys to test a tall neighbour.

How this was made. Block outlines, stack positions and window sides come from the brochure's site plan and floor plans. Storeys are 2.8 m with a 4 m void deck. Existing HDB blocks within 5 km come from the data.gov.sg building footprints joined to HDB Property Information storeys. Roads close to each site and the MRT viaduct are traced from the site plans. Facade colours come from the brochures' artist impressions. Factories, schools, the church and the reserved sites are my approximations.

Brochure notes say all surrounding forms and heights are subject to change. Treat the view and sun results as a guide and visit the site before booking.
